title: Strength SMP Datapack
description: A fan-made datapack based off the popular YouTuber SMP "Strength SMP" !
body:
My very first datapack! Hope you like it!
# What is this?
This is a fan-made datapack recreation of the plugin used in the popular YouTuber SMP Series "Strength SMP"!
# Why?
I made this initially for a private server with my friends since we liked this server idea. Since there were no mods based off Strength SMP for fabric, I decided to code a datapack (I do not like java lol so I didn't make a mod).
# Current Features
Currently this has the base of Strength SMP

**Minimum and maximum strength**: This has a minimum strength of +0 and a maximum of +5. While I do realise the minimum in the real plugin is +1, I decided to make it +0 as a balance.

**Strength bottle items**: You can do a command to withdraw strength and turn it into strength bottles, which can be claimed by right-clicking while holding the bottle:

**To withdraw once**: 
```
/function strengthsmp:withdraw
```
Or for non-operators:

```
/trigger withdraw
```

**To withdraw multiple strength (x is number of strength to be withdrawn)**:
```
/function strengthsmp:withdrawmulti {amount:x}
```
You can also craft strength bottles (recipe is different to official):

![How to craft the Strength Bottle (from top to bottom, left to right): diamond, enchanted golden apple, diamond, golden apple, heavy core, golden apple, diamond, blaze rod, diamond](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afead82c63bba7f33e534dcb2c789f1c9f6bbc0c.png)
# Planned Features
**I mainly plan to add weapon abilities like in the Strength SMP, but I am open to suggestions!**
